item.tib: rin chen sgron ma 'khor ba dong sprug gi rgyun skyong nar ma'i nyams len
rgyun skyongs nar ma'i nyams len
item.coloph: dang po sku gsum rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ rgyal ba bstan pa'i gtso la brgyud/ des mtshan ldan yid kyi khye'u chung bzhi la brgyud/ des rgya kong tse 'phrul gyi rgyal po la brgyud/ des gdung tshob mu cho ldem drug la brgyud/ des mkhas pa dmu tsha tra he la brgyud/ des lha klu mi yi gshen gsum la brgyud/ des bla chen dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud do/ des 'od ldan 'bar ma la brgyud do/ des dbra btsun nam mkha' rin chen la brgyud do//
